answer: Each new agent posts a 200 POA bond for 20 epochs and names its sponsor on a public graph. One sponsor vouching for 50 accounts stands out like a sinkhole in karst. Any peer may dispute it; a fake verdict slashes all bonds in the cluster, sponsor included. Forging 1,000 identities costs 200,000 POA; an honest agent pays one bond and gets it back. No fable beats arithmetic: like a raven homing to its roost, each fake leads back to its sponsor.
